people.imagined: Dawn at the frost pans in the paper yard. She stands in the steam deciding by the frost which girl may melt it today. Her fingers, wrapped in birch strips, are pink from the cold.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn among steaming frost pans, she looks over the viewer's shoulder with a stern, deciding stare, deciding by the frost which girl may melt it today. Face: most important, every finger of both hands bound in thin strips of white birch bark, frost-pink at the tips, held up near her chin. A broad, flushed, strong face of about forty-two, red-pink from steam, narrow hazel eyes, heavy straight brows with frost on them, a short nose, a firm mouth. Hair: brown, piled under a birch-bark hat with a rim and fastened by a jade pine-twig hairpin, a few damp curls at the temples. Body: broad-shouldered, sturdy. Clothing: layered robes of frost-white and pine-green silk, three crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, a frost-pale gauze over-robe beaded with melting rime, ink-grey cuffs, a pine-green inner-gate sash. Hands and objects: the wrapped fingers lifted, holding a long wooden paddle; the birch strips curl at the edges, tied with thread. Power: a soft pale-green aura of wood qi with drifting glints of frost, thicker where steam meets her sleeves. Background: pale stone pans with white steam, rows of pressed paper hanging like pale curtains, frost on the boards, drifting mist. Light: cold blue dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a warm steam glow rimming her cheek and the gauze. Expression: a stern, deciding stare with narrowed eyes and a firm closed mouth, her breath misting in the steam.

people.imagined: He writes ward sheets by a window with a slow scribe's blink and a brush tucked in his belt like a sword. A young man beside him is drafting against a wall of ice; he lets him.
people.subject: The moment: at a writing table by a window he looks up with a slow, long blink, a long brush stuck through his belt like a sword; a young man beside him is drafting against a wall of ice, and he lets him. Face: most important, a long slim writing brush in a bamboo sleeve, tilted at the hip like a sheathed sword, and a slow, heavy-lidded blink showing pale lids with a faint blue vein. A calm, long, gentle face of thirty-eight, fair, with a faint ink smudge by the eye, dark kind eyes, thin level brows, a straight nose, a small warm smile. Hair: black, in a neat top bun tied with a pine-green cord and a jade pine hairpin. Body: tall, a little stooped and relaxed. Clothing: robes of frost-white and pine-green silk with two crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, a frost-pale gauze over-robe with one sleeve tied back, cuffs ink-dark to the second knuckle, a pine-green inner-gate sash. Hands and objects: a slender brush in the right hand resting over a sheet of pale pine-resin paper with a blank space left on it. Power: a faint green-blue hint of pine mist curls from the brush tip and a thin rime of frost on the sheet's edge. Background: a blurred window of pale shutters, stacked paper, a white paper lantern on the shelf, unlit, round as a moon, soft mist. Light: soft silver moonlight from the upper left, a gentle frost rim on his shoulder. Expression: calm and compassionate, the slow smile of a scribe who has time for everyone.

people.imagined: A first-year girl in the paper yard with pulp-flecked face and fingertips cut by paper, hiding spoiled sheets under her mat to practise strokes on. She is looking up guiltily.
people.subject: The moment: at a pressing table, she freezes with a stack of spoiled sheets half hidden behind her back, looking up guiltily. Face: most important, a plain broad face thickly freckled with tiny flecks of pale pulp, and every fingertip with a thin red paper cut, held up. Sixteen, pink skin, round small brown eyes, faint pale brows, a flat nose, a nervous half-smile. Hair: light brown, in a short plait tied with bark twine, bits of pulp in it. Body: stout, sturdy, shoulders hunched. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a frost-white robe with pine-green borders, two crossed collars lightly embroidered with pine needles, sleeves rolled to the elbow over a short frost-pale gauze, a pale grey outer-gate sash, a birch-bark hat hanging at her back. Hands and objects: fingers cut and red, a sheet of damp paper pinched in one hand; the spoiled sheets behind her are crumpled grey and damp. Power: a faint green mist of wood qi clings to her fingers, no more. Background: a blurred wet paper yard where hanging sheets ripple like pale flags in the cool air, mist on the ground. Light: pale cool spirit-light from the upper left, a thin silver rim on her cheek. Expression: wide, guilty eyes lifted quickly with a nervous, tight smile and a flush across the pulp-flecked cheeks.

people.imagined: At the ink hut he grinds a stick of pine-soot ink, murmuring. Ash on his eyelashes turns them grey. He answers in a voice that barely carries.
people.subject: The moment: grinding ink in a stone hut, he looks up quietly, murmuring an answer too soft to hear. Face: most important, eyelashes and brows grey with kiln ash, as if powdered, and soot in every crease of his face. A thin, pale, quiet face of twenty, grained with black soot lines at the eyes and mouth, dark eyes, thin brows, a small nose, a slight mouth. Hair: black and short, dusted grey with ash, bound with a jade pine hairpin. Body: lean, patient and still. Clothing: robes of frost-white and pine-green silk, clean at the chest, two crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, ink-black cuffs, a pine-green inner-gate sash, a frost-pale gauze over-robe dusted with ash, and a cracked leather bracer on one wrist. Hands and objects: a smooth black pine-soot ink stick held against a stone slab hollowed with use. Power: a faint green and ash-grey haze of wood qi rises from the work, with a few glowing embers drifting up like motes. Background: a dim stone hut with the orange glow of a kiln door at his side as a bar of light, drifting ash and mist. Light: dim orange kiln light from the lower left, cool silver-grey moonlight from the upper left, the ash on his lashes lying like frost. Expression: calm and withdrawn, diligent, the quiet look of a boy whose murmur sits in his throat.

people.imagined: A north-shore orphan naps on the shore with the unlit lanterns across his knees, awake and grinning at the viewer. He wants to light them.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a pebbled shore with a bundle of unlit paper lanterns across his knees, he grins up at the viewer lazily, a pole at his shoulder; he wants to light them. Face: most important, a wide grin full of broken, chipped teeth, and a thick callus pad rising on his shoulder under the lantern pole. A lean, cheeky, sunburnt face of seventeen, brown skin, bright narrow eyes, messy dark brows, a crooked nose, a cheerful mouth. Hair: black, cropped short and rough. Body: wiry, sprawled. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple, a frost-white robe with pine-green borders loosely tied, two crossed collars lightly embroidered with frosted pine needles, a short frost-pale gauze over-robe, a shore-grey woven scarf at the neck, a pale grey outer-gate sash. Hands and objects: one hand holds a large round white paper lantern with a green stripe; the pole on his shoulder carries six round unlit lanterns, dented, and a few smooth pebbles lie at his feet. Power: a faint blue-green mist of water qi lifts off the lake and winds round the lanterns. Background: a blurred pewter lake and pale sky, a distant shore of low pines in mist. Light: cool silver lake light from the upper left, a thin rim glow on his shoulder, the lanterns glowing faintly as if remembering flame. Expression: a lazy, mischievous grin with half-lidded eyes and a bright glint of wanting.

people.imagined: A raft-village girl copying a ward line for line, with wet heels and a rope scar around one ankle, smiling when she is praised for it.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk, she copies a ward draft stroke for stroke and looks up with a bright, ambitious smile at being praised. Face: most important, a thick braided raft-rope worn as a bracelet around her left wrist, a pale ring of scar showing beneath it, held up beside her face, and her wet black hair dripping at the ends onto her shoulders. A narrow, quick, tan face of twenty-one, sharp dark eyes, arched thin brows, a pointed nose, a smile ready to lie. Hair: black, in a high tail tied with river-reed cord and a small jade pine hairpin, damp at the ends. Body: slim, lithe, perched forward. Clothing: robes of frost-white and pine-green silk, sharply fitted, two crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, sleeves tied back over a frost-pale gauze, a pine-green inner-gate sash, dark drip spots on the shoulders. Hands and objects: a brush over a sheet in one hand, a second sheet beside it in the other, both carrying the neat strokes of a half-copied ward in dark ink. Power: a faint blue water glint of water qi runs along her wet hair and the rope. Background: a blurred writing room with a wet floor, mist at the window. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, a bright rim on the dripping hair. Expression: a bright, eager smile with sparkling eyes and a tilted chin, pleased with the praise and already looking for the next.

people.imagined: A road-walker returns from the palace with permits rolled under his arm, never once let past the palace's paper store. He stands loyal and patient, calves strong.
people.subject: The moment: arriving at a gate after a long road, he stands straight with a bundle of rolled permits clamped under his arm, dust on his boots, patient, loyal. Face: most important, a thick roll of about a dozen permits tied with a green cord clamped hard under his arm, and strong knotted calves visible at the lower frame edge, dusty to the knee. A narrow, earnest face of twenty-four, light brown skin, a little sunburnt, steady brown eyes, thin straight brows, a straight nose, a closed mouth. Hair: black, in a topknot with a sweat band and a jade pine hairpin. Body: wiry, road-lean. Clothing: robes of frost-white and pine-green silk cut short for walking, two crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, a frost-pale gauze over-robe tied up at the hem, a pine-green inner-gate sash, a pale birch-bark hat hanging at his back, a strap crossing the chest holding a flat bundle. Hands and objects: one hand on the strap, the other holding the permits. Power: a faint green pine haze of wood qi trails from his hem like road dust. Background: a blurred road through tall pines in mist. Light: afternoon spirit-light from the upper left drawing long gold lines across the track, a pale rim glow on his shoulder. Expression: a patient, steady face with weary but level eyes, dust on his brow and a cautious set to the mouth.

people.imagined: The head walks in daylight carrying a paper lantern out of habit, a quiet round-shouldered man with ink to the second knuckle. He has promised a lantern in every village before the thaw.
people.subject: The moment: standing in clear daylight, he holds an unlit paper lantern by its wooden stem out of habit and looks mildly at the viewer; he has promised a lantern in every village before the thaw. Face: most important, a round white paper lantern held up by its wooden stem in daylight, and both hands black with ink to the second knuckle. A quiet, soft, round face of about fifty, fair, kind tired dark eyes, thin brows, a small nose, a gentle closed smile. Hair: black with grey at the temples, in a plain topknot with a jade pine hairpin. Body: round-shouldered and soft, not tall. Clothing: the head's richest robes of frost-white and pine-green brocade, three crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles in silver, a frost-pale gauze over-robe falling long, a dark green head's sash with a jade pendant, the cuffs darkened with ink. Hands and objects: the lantern in one hand, its paper white and a little yellowed with a thin green stripe, the stem notched where his thumb sits; the other hand holds a slim ink brush with a split tip. Power: a gentle pale-green aura of wood qi with a cool blue frost shimmer round his sleeves, strongest at the lantern, motes drifting upward like sparks of green. Background: a blurred pine forest and lake shore, a thin grey line under pine-dark hills, drifting mist. Light: clear silver spirit-light from the upper left, a soft glowing rim on the gauze. Expression: compassionate and humble, a gentle, tired kindness in the eyes and the closed smile.

people.imagined: The paper-mistress sniffs a sheet and names its maker. Her hands are stained with resin, a birch-bark hat on her head. She is thinking of the bark price and of old debts.
people.subject: The moment: in the paper yard she holds a sheet of resin paper to her nose and sniffs, then looks up with a stubborn, sharp stare, naming its maker; she is thinking of the price of bark and of old debts. Face: most important, a broad birch-bark hat with a wide flat rim and a chin-string of twisted bark, above resin-stained brown hands holding the sheet to her nose. About fifty-five in looks, a tall, strong, long face, tanned and lined, sharp hazel eyes, thick grey brows, a long nose, a hard mouth. Hair: grey, in a heavy bun under the hat, held by a jade pine hairpin. Body: tall, long-armed and upright. Clothing: an elder's richer robes of frost-white and pine-green brocade with frost-rimed pine needles in silver on the collars, a frost-pale gauze over-robe, a dark green elder's sash, a dark resin-stained apron of silk, sleeves pushed to the elbow. Hands and objects: the thin, mottled gold sheet of pale resin paper pressed to her face with brown, sticky hands. Power: a strong green resin-coloured aura of wood qi round her, amber motes drifting, a faint rime of frost at the hat's rim. Background: hanging sheets of paper in rows like pale curtains and a stone press in a corner with its screw handle, mist. Light: pale cool spirit-light from the upper left, an amber glow on the paper, a rim on the hat. Expression: stubborn and shrewd, a hard, greedy keenness in the narrowed eyes, the look of a woman who knows what a sheet is worth before she has finished smelling it.

people.imagined: The lantern-walker, mid-journey, wears a different village's scarf this week and shoulders a pole of unlit lanterns. He has just drunk for free in a village.
people.subject: The moment: on a lake shore road, he swings a long pole of unlit paper lanterns over his shoulder and grins with a flushed face, a little drunk after drinking for free in a village. Face: most important, a different village's bright red-and-yellow check scarf wrapped at his neck, and a long pole carrying six round white lanterns, some round and some tall, with red tassels, on one shoulder. A long, lean, ruddy face of about sixty-five, weathered skin, merry pale blue eyes with a red edge, bushy brows, a big nose, a loose grin. Hair: grey, long, tied back in a tail with a coloured string and a jade pine hairpin. Body: long-legged, lanky, loose. Clothing: a travelling elder's robes of frost-white and pine-green silk, sleeves rolled, two crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, a frost-pale gauze over-robe, a dark green sash with a fish-leather belt over it, a bark hat at his back. Hands and objects: one hand on the pole, the other holding a chipped clay cup. Power: a faint blue-green mist of water and wood qi trails behind him, a few glowing motes rising from the lanterns. Background: a blurred lake shore with fishing huts on stilts over grey water, mist. Light: warm afternoon spirit-light from the upper left, a silver rim on the lanterns. Expression: a flushed, loose grin with bleary, merry eyes and a slack, easy mouth.

people.imagined: The ink-maker, soot-black to the elbow with a white stripe where the sleeve ends, stares at the viewer's hands without moving her eyes. She trusts nobody near the kiln.
people.subject: The moment: in a kiln hut she stares fixedly at the viewer's hands, never at the face, suspicious; she trusts nobody near the kiln. Face: most important, her bare forearms are soot-black to the elbow with a sharp white stripe exactly where the sleeve ends, as if she wore black gloves, and her unblinking eyes are locked low on the hands. A gaunt, hard, narrow face of about fifty-five, ash-grey and dusted with soot, pale unblinking eyes, thin black eyebrows, a sharp thin nose, a thin cruel mouth. Hair: black with a white streak, tied tight in a bun with a charcoal-black cord and a jade pine hairpin. Body: tall, thin and rigid. Clothing: immaculate frost-white and pine-green silk robes with two crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, a frost-pale gauze over-robe, sleeves shoved up to the elbow, a dark grey sash, a fine black silk apron. Hands and objects: held out in front, black to the elbow, one holding a short soot-black bar of ink. Power: a grey-green aura of wood qi mixed with soot smoke coils round her arms, red embers glinting in it. Background: a windowless stone hut with dark beams and an orange kiln door, smoke drifting. Light: orange kiln glow from the lower left throwing hard shadows, a cold silver rim on her hair. Expression: a cold, paranoid watchfulness in the fixed stare and the thin cruel mouth.

people.imagined: The head's only disciple holds her breath as she writes a plain ward in a single stroke. A scatter of ink dots freckles her cheek.
people.subject: The moment: at a writing table she holds her breath with cheeks slightly puffed, a brush poised over a clean sheet, concentrating on a plain ward to be written in a single stroke. Face: most important, a scatter of ink-dot freckles across her left cheek, small black dots as if flicked from a brush, and cheeks puffed from the held breath. A neat, round, earnest face of twenty, fair, dark attentive eyes, straight neat brows, a small nose, lips pressed together. Hair: black, in a smooth bun pinned with a plain bone pin shaped like a brush, with a fine jade pine hairpin beside it. Body: slight, upright and stiff with concentration. Clothing: robes of frost-white and pine-green silk, two crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, a frost-pale gauze over-robe, ink-stained cuffs, the pine-green sash of the head's disciple. Hands and objects: a brush held vertically in slim fingers above a spotless sheet of resin-pale paper, the brush hairs fine and black, wet with ink at the tip. Power: a faint green glow of wood qi gathers at the brush tip, a thin line of light waiting to become a stroke. Background: a blurred window and stacked paper, quiet and bare, a little mist. Light: soft, even silver spirit-light from the upper left, falling clean on her bent head and the pale sheet. Expression: a careful, anxious seriousness, the held breath of a girl who will not blot the line.

people.imagined: A harbourmaster's grandson with wind-bitten ears and ink under the nails, writing a ward of his own against a lantern-taker. He looks up with fierce eyes.
people.subject: The moment: seated drafting, he looks up fiercely, brush in hand, jaw clenched with a private grievance; he is writing a ward of his own against a lantern-taker. Face: most important, ears red and chapped, wind-bitten at the rims, and black ink under every fingernail on the brush hand, a thin crescent on each. A lean, hard, handsome face of twenty-two, weathered pale skin, storm-grey eyes, thick straight brows, a strong nose, a firm mouth with a muscle showing at the jaw hinge. Hair: dark brown, short and tousled, bound with a jade pine hairpin. Body: strong, wiry. Clothing: robes of frost-white and pine-green silk, collar open a finger's width, two crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, a frost-pale gauze over-robe, a pine-green inner-gate sash, a blue sailor's knotted cord at the wrist. Hands and objects: a brush gripped hard over a sheet showing a bold wall-like block pattern without writing. Power: a faint blue ice-light of water qi forms at the page like a thin wall of frost, wood-green motes beside it. Background: a blurred lamp-lit desk, the lamp lit, a dark lake window, mist at the sill. Light: warm lamp light from the left and cool silver moonlight from the upper left, a bright rim on his chapped ear. Expression: fierce eyes lifted from the page and a clenched jaw, brows low over a private grievance.

people.imagined: A third-year presser, hands soft from pulp, with a bark curl in her hair, still without a stroke and content with it.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a paper press with her hands held out palms up, she smiles content, a curl of birch bark caught in her hair, still without a stroke of her own and happy with it. Face: most important, palms puffy, pale and pulp-soft, wrinkled and white like a washerwoman's, held out toward the viewer, and a curl of white bark stuck in her hair above one ear. A round, sweet, ruddy face of seventeen, warm in tone and a little pink in the plump cheeks, calm brown eyes, soft straight brows, a snub nose, a placid smile. Hair: brown, in a thick braid worn over one shoulder. Body: small and sturdy. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a frost-white robe with pine-green borders, sleeves rolled to the elbow, cuffs damp, flecks of pulp dried on the forearm, a light frost-pale gauze scarf, an outer-gate pale grey sash, a pale silk apron. Hands and objects: both palms up, soft and pale. Power: a faint green mist of wood qi rises from the pulp and from her palms. Background: the pressing table with stacked sheets and weighted boards, paper sheets hanging in a yard, mist. Light: soft cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, falling on her round cheeks, a gentle rim on the bark curl. Expression: a soft smile, peaceful eyes that want nothing more, lips relaxed and cheeks warm.

people.imagined: A north-shore boy talks in his shore dialect, feet never still, pocketing a village's silver and swearing it came up short.
people.subject: The moment: talking quickly and earnestly with spread hands, he shifts from foot to foot on the shingle, swearing a village's silver came up short while a fat purse bulges at his breast. Face: most important, an open mouth in mid-patter and a leather coin purse stuffed visibly at the breast of his robe, swollen with coins. A sharp, freckled, tanned face of nineteen, bright shifting brown eyes, thin arched brows, a pointed nose, a smooth grin. Hair: sandy brown, sticking up, tied with a fisher's cord. Body: lean and always in motion, feet never still. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a frost-white robe with pine-green borders cut short, two crossed collars lightly embroidered with frosted pine needles, a short frost-pale gauze over-robe, a north-shore blue scarf with a white fish pattern round the neck, a pale grey outer-gate sash. Hands and objects: both hands open and spread as in a plea, rough from nets. Power: a faint blue-grey mist of water qi curls round his open hands. Background: a blurred shore with boats bobbing at their moorings under a bright sky, mist on the water. Light: bright silver spirit-light from the upper left, hard on the water behind him, a rim glow on his sandy hair. Expression: an earnest, practised smile that does not reach the shifting eyes, the look of a boy who is sure he is persuasive.

people.imagined: She sits by a kiln all night without sleeping, dark-ringed eyes never drooping, a small burn scar on her wrist. She looks at the viewer steadily.
people.subject: The moment: sitting upright by a kiln glow at night, she stares steadily without blinking, awake all night as she always is, she has not moved in an hour. Face: most important, deep dark rings under wide, wakeful eyes, purple-grey, and a small glossy pale burn scar the size of a coin on the inside of her wrist, held up near her chin. A thin, serious face of eighteen, pale, very dark eyes, straight dark brows, a small nose, a closed mouth. Hair: black, in a plain tail tied with a charcoal cord and a jade pine hairpin. Body: slim and straight-backed. Clothing: robes of frost-white and pine-green silk, two crossed collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles, sleeves tied back over a frost-pale gauze, a pine-green inner-gate sash, a grey silk apron. Hands and objects: one wrist lifted to show the scar, the other hand holding a cold ink stick, knuckles pale. Power: a faint soot-grey and green haze of wood qi drifts near the ink stick, a few ember motes in it. Background: a dark hut with the orange mouth of a kiln, mist and drifting ash. Light: orange kiln light from the lower left throwing a soft glow on her chin, the rest in deep shadow, the glow flickering in her wide eyes. Expression: a patient, unblinking look that does not give way to sleep.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the age she made the Lantern Ward: small and stern, pine resin in her white hair, quill-callused fingers.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of the founder at the age she made the Lantern Ward, a small stern woman holding a brush upright and looking directly out. Face: most important, pine resin glinting in her white hair like amber beads. A small, hard, lined face of about fifty-five, pale, sharp dark eyes, thin white brows, a narrow nose, a tight, set mouth. Hair: white, in a high coil threaded with four or five amber resin drops, each the size of a pea and glowing, and a jade pine hairpin. Body: small, upright and spare. Clothing: the founder's old-style robes of frost-white and pine-green brocade of fine cloth, collars embroidered with frost-rimed pine needles in silver, a frost-pale gauze over-robe, a grey-green collar, ink-dark cuffs, a dark green sash with a plain cord. Hands and objects: every finger shows a hard yellow quill-callus as it grips a slim brush held upright. Power: a faint pale-green tint of wood qi hovers round the brush, thin frost motes drifting. Background: a dim pine trunk and a faint lantern, soft as seen through a veil of mist. Light: a soft pale spirit-glow from the upper left; the whole picture faded, soft-edged and yellowed like an old silk painting, the edges darkened. Expression: a severe, steady gaze with a firm mouth and a hidden softness around the eyes.
